changes.before: Maintain your Columbia Automatic Taper with the genuine CT72 cable. This replacement part ensures consistent mechanical performance for professional finishers.
changes.after: The Columbia Tools CT72 Cable is a genuine replacement for Columbia automatic taper equipment. Confirm the part number and schematic location before ordering.

changes.before: Reduce fatigue with the Columbia Matrix Flat Box Handle. Features a patented ergonomic grip and lightweight aluminum design for professional drywall finishing.
changes.after: The Columbia Matrix Flat Box Handle supports control during drywall finishing work with lightweight aluminum construction and an ergonomic grip.

changes.before: Transition to automatic drywall finishing with the LEVEL5 Entry to Automatic Finishing Set. Choose Tools Only or the complete Taper kit for professional speed.
changes.after: Transition to automatic drywall finishing with the LEVEL5 Entry to Automatic Finishing Set. Choose Tools Only or the complete Taper kit for your setup.

changes.before: The Platinum Semi Automatic Drywall Taper (PT-TP) simplifies joint taping by integrating mud application and tape dispensing for efficient, consistent results.
changes.after: The Platinum Semi Automatic Drywall Taper (PT-TP) mounts to a standard 5-gallon joint compound bucket and applies mud to tape as it is pulled through.

changes.before: Restore your flat box handle with the TapeTech Grip Assembly For Box Handle 804003F. This genuine OEM part restores control and comfort to your finishing tool.
changes.after: Restore your flat box handle with the TapeTech Grip Assembly For Box Handle 804003F. This OEM replacement restores control and comfort to your finishing tool.

changes.after: USG Sheetrock 8 X 3-inch textured-head, coarse-thread drywall screws with TENZ feature a textured head for improved mud adhesion. Package weight: 5 lb.

changes.after: USG Sheetrock #6 x 1-5/8-inch coarse-thread drywall screws with TENZ have a textured head for mud adhesion. Bulk package; shipping weight: 22.8 lb.

changes.before: The LEVEL5 Outside Corner Tool (4-746) applies compound to 90° outside corners for bead installation. Compatible with MiniShot, Compound Tubes, and Applicators.
